callout.title: ⚠️ One thing to decide today: the Sunday / Day-1 conflict
callout.body: Aso Oke's week runs Sun→Sat, so every week's first task lands on the plan's zero-exception free day — and today that task is a full recording session (speaker, quiet room, consent), not a 5-minute job. Quietly repeating the Aug 23 precedent isn't "zero exceptions" — it's a standing exception nobody chose. Pick deliberately:

options.label: Option A — short session today
options.detail: Time-boxed 5:30–6:30 PM, borrowed from the home-projects evening slot rather than family/church time. Sunday stays mostly free, not entirely free.

options.label: Option B — fully free today (the plan's recommendation)
options.detail: Shift Day 22 into Saturday's 2–5 PM Aso Oke block (or next Saturday). No gate depends on the recording happening today — the only hard date is the Day 28 checkpoint, Sat Sep 5. This is the only option that actually honors "zero exceptions."

tasks.title: Day 22 — First recording session (1–2 speakers)

tasks.title: Day 23b — RERUN: MADLAD-400 baseline for real
tasks.detail: Closes a real gap: Week 1 actually ran NLLB (now retired — license-blocked for commercialization). The Phase 1 gate (MADLAD-400 BLEU ≥20) is unverified until this runs. Self-contained cell already in the Weeks 2–3 runbook notebook. ~5 min active + 30–60 min unattended GPU. If BLEU <20 in either direction → apply the 10B-promotion rule now, not at Week 8.
